messages.subject: envelope properties
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I am trying to obtain the skewness and kurtosis of a time envelope.

Here is an example: http://www.plosone.org/article/info%3Adoi%2F10.1371%2Fjournal.pone.0102842

I have written a function, copying part of the "specprop" function, however the results are bizarre.

Any help would be highly useful

All the best!

Felipe

Here is the code and some tests:

library(seewave)

envprop <- function(envel, smo, f) {

envAmp <- envel

envTime <- seq(1:length(envAmp))*(smo/f)

amp <- envAmp/sum(envAmp)

w <- sd(amp)

L <- length(envAmp)

        skew <- (sum((amp - mean(amp))^3)/(L - 1))/w^3

        kurt <- (sum((amp - mean(amp))^4)/(L - 1))/w^4

plot(amp~envTime, type="l")

legend("bottom", legend=c(paste("Skew = ", round(skew,6), sep=""), paste("Kurt = ", round(kurt, 6), sep="")))

results <- list(skew=skew, kurt=kurt)

return(results)

}

smo=30

f=44100

a <- synth(f=f, d=1, cf=1000)

# test for positive skew

a1 <- fadew(a, f=f, din=0.2, dout=0.8)

osc <- oscillo(a1, f=f, plot=F)

envel <- env(osc, msmooth=c(smo,0), f=f, plot=F)

envprop(envel=envel, smo=smo, f=f)

# test for negative skew

a2 <- fadew(a, f=f, din=0.8, dout=0.2)

osc <- oscillo(a2, f=f, plot=F)

envel <- env(osc, msmooth=c(smo,0), f=f, plot=F)

envprop(envel=envel, smo=smo, f=f)

#test for kurtosis of different windows

awh <- ftwindow(44100, wn="hanning")

a3 <- a*awh

osc <- oscillo(a3, f=f, plot=F)

envel <- env(osc, msmooth=c(smo,0), f=f, plot=F)

envprop(envel=envel, smo=smo, f=f)

awf <- ftwindow(44100, wn="flattop")

a4 <- a*awf

osc <- oscillo(a4, f=f, plot=F)

envel <- env(osc, msmooth=c(smo,0), f=f, plot=F)

envprop(envel=envel, smo=smo, f=f)

Hi Jerome

The CRAN info for fftw identified Olaf Mersmann (Dortmund, Germany) as the maintainer of the package.  I emailed him this morning and he wrote straight back.  He's going to install an OpenSUSE VM on his machine and try to debug the process for me.  It may come down to static versus dynamic versions and how R sees those.  I'm hopeful that Olaf can sort it for me.

Thanks for taking an interest in sorting my problem.

best wishes

Lawrie
